modules.name: Repository Management Control Plane
modules.objective: Keep project truth, work sequencing, risks, decisions and evidence repository-backed.
boundaries: No application behavior changes without a separate work unit.
completion_evidence: PR #33 and PR #34 passed App Validation and merged

modules.name: Local Development on Prisma SQLite
modules.objective: Provide fast Shopify-default-style Local development on Prisma + SQLite before Staging begins.
boundaries: No Local Neon account/project credential requirement.
Never reuse Staging or Production database credentials.
Local SQLite acceptance is not PostgreSQL acceptance.
security_responsibilities: Local SQLite database files remain gitignored.
No hosted database credentials are required for normal Local development.
acceptance_criteria: Shared schema parity with cloud PostgreSQL is automatically checked.
npm run dev reaches VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev.
Local certification records a passing SQLite development health response and exact source ref.
completion_evidence: Local SQLite runtime wiring, migration, validation and certification implemented on PR #64.
App Validation #271 passed Local SQLite migration/parity and all repository checks.
Real workstation Shopify Dev runtime acceptance remains pending.
update_notes: Repository implementation is complete; runtime verification on merged development is the remaining Local gate.

modules.name: Isolated Staging
modules.objective: After Local certification, certify the dedicated Shopify Staging app, Cloudflare Worker, Neon PostgreSQL and Queue runtime.

modules.name: Guarded Production Promotion
modules.objective: Prepare/release Production only from verified main after Staging acceptance.
boundaries: No production release without exact authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Production release is separately authorized and verified.

modules.name: Environment-Aware Prisma Data Architecture
modules.objective: Use Prisma SQLite for Local development and Prisma PostgreSQL on isolated Neon databases for Staging/Production, with automated shared-schema parity.
boundaries: Local SQLite files must be gitignored.
No Local reuse of Staging or Production credentials.
No Staging/Production credential reuse across hosted environments.
No production migration during Shopify release.
acceptance_criteria: Staging and Production Neon identities remain isolated.
Session shop lookup remains indexed in hosted PostgreSQL.
completion_evidence: Hosted PostgreSQL schema contract and Session.shop index are CI-validated.
Local SQLite schema and migration path are CI-validated.
Shared Local/cloud Prisma model parity is CI-validated by App Validation #271.
Staging and Production retain isolated Neon PostgreSQL identities.
update_notes: Database architecture is complete at repository level; environment runtime acceptance is handled by Local/Staging promotion gates.

modules.name: Four-Tier Shopify Billing and Entitlements
modules.objective: Provide four stable subscription tiers with a shared 10-day trial contract and server-side entitlement resolution.
boundaries: Exactly four stable IDs: starter, growth, pro, unlimited.
Do not expose unimplemented options as available runtime capabilities.
Production real billing is only used after guarded release.
security_responsibilities: Validate exact subscription identity, price, interval, trial and test mode.
Do not trust client-provided plan entitlements.
acceptance_criteria: New manual Billing API subscriptions use 10-day trials.
Plan changes use Shopify replacement behavior.
Legacy USD 55/5-day subscriptions retain compatible access.
completion_evidence: Plans UI and subscription API updated.
App Validation #224 passed before this batch.
update_notes: Runtime plan approval still requires Shopify test-store evidence.
Public Shopify App Pricing migration remains a separate release decision.
